name: Large storage travel bag (RM42)
description:
Cute and classy, this flip open duffle bag has a slight shine to the fabric and extremely spacious pockets to carry around your stuff in. The front of the bag is covered in pockets and see sides contain detachable straps.
• Front pocket detail
• Detachable adjustable strap
• Twin handle
• Flip open zipper closure
Size & fit information
Width : 47cm, height: 18 cm, thickness : 21cm, weight : 0.26kg
Compartment- 1: Pocket- 6
Fabric Composition: Polyester Oxford Cloth
Wash Care; Hand Wash
